summary: Steward post-race cleanup: debug-log entry, frees D3D audio state pointer at this+0xA8, resets comparison/camera director state, frees state arrays at this+0x110 and this+0x114, conditionally refreshes season scoring, resets every vehicle substate, frees the counted array at this+0x1AC (with its container), and zeroes 52 dword-pairs starting at this+0x1B0 and this+0x280.

operations.description: If StringSplitLoop(2, aDDevF119992002_3, 2855) returns non-zero, log 'Entered Steward Post' via DebugLogWrite(&dword_8AD25C, aEnteredSteward_2).
If the D3D audio state pointer at this+0xA8 is non-null, run D3DStateInit on it, re-read this+0xA8 and free it via FreeWrapper_7bcf, then set this+0xA8 to 0.
Set this+0xA8 to 0 after freeing the audio state.
ArithmeticComparison_2e20(this) resets comparison state on the steward object.
sub_4D24D0() runs a follow-up reset routine.
If the state array pointer at this+0x110 is non-null, free it via FreeWrapper_7bcf and set this+0x110 to 0.
If the pointer at this+0x114 is non-null, free it via FreeWrapper_7bcf and set this+0x114 to 0.
If dword_7D0410 != 4, call SeasonScoringInfoUpdater(dword_7D2DB0) to refresh season scoring.
For i in [0, dword_5C329C): call StructResetReinitializer(dword_7C54F0[i] + 16436) to reset each vehicle substate (16436 = 0x4034).
Second check of this+0x110: if still non-null, free it again via FreeWrapper_7bcf and set this+0x110 to 0.

If the counted array pointer at this+0x1AC is non-null, read its element count from the container header (ptr-4), walk the 8-byte-strided element slots from the last to the first freeing each non-null element via FreeWrapper_7bcf, free the container header, then set this+0x1AC to 0.
Zero 52 pairs of dwords: for each of 52 iterations write 0 at (this+0x1B0 + 8*k) and (this+0x280 + 8*k), clearing two parallel arrays of 52 entries each.
Return result, a pointer just past the zeroed 52-pair region.
